hints.title: K-Length Window Sums
hints.text: Precompute the sum of every contiguous window of length k across the array using a sliding window or prefix sums.

hints.title: Left and Right Maximums
hints.text: For each candidate middle window, determine the best starting index to its left and the best starting index to its right.

hints.title: Middle Window Sweep
hints.text: Precompute array left where left[i] is the starting index of the maximum window in range 0 to i. Similarly build array right for the suffix. Iterate through all valid middle window positions to maximize the three window sums.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maxSumOfThreeSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        W = []
        curr = sum(nums[:k])
        W.append(curr)
        for i in range(k, n):
            curr += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
            W.append(curr)

        m = len(W)
        left = [0] * m
        best = 0
        for i in range(m):
            if W[i] > W[best]:
                best = i
            left[i] = best

        right = [0] * m
        best = m - 1
        for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
            if W[i] >= W[best]:
                best = i
            right[i] = best

        max_total = 0
        ans = []
        for mid in range(k, m - k):
            l, r = left[mid - k], right[mid + k]
            total = W[l] + W[mid] + W[r]
            if total > max_total:
                max_total = total
                ans = [l, mid, r]
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Precompute prefix and suffix best starting indices to evaluate middle subarray in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force triple loops checking all combinations of 3 subarrays take O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching best left and right indices in O(N) memory allows a single pass scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use dynamic programming prefix/suffix tables to resolve lexicographical tie-breaking cleanly.
